executions_end_reason_check.name: executions_end_reason_check
executions_end_reason_check.value: "executions"."status" not in ('failed', 'cancelled') or "executions"."end_reason" is not null

legacy_hotel_mappings_decision_check.name: legacy_hotel_mappings_decision_check
legacy_hotel_mappings_decision_check.value:
("legacy_hotel_mappings"."decision" <> 'confirmed' or "legacy_hotel_mappings"."hotel_code" is not null)
        and ("legacy_hotel_mappings"."decision" <> 'unmapped' or "legacy_hotel_mappings"."hotel_code" is null)

treatment_documents_state_check.name: treatment_documents_state_check
treatment_documents_state_check.value:
("treatment_documents"."state" = 'current' and "treatment_documents"."ended_at" is null)
        or ("treatment_documents"."state" in ('replaced', 'removed') and "treatment_documents"."ended_at" is not null)
        or "treatment_documents"."state" = 'purged'

treatment_documents_purged_check.name: treatment_documents_purged_check
treatment_documents_purged_check.value:
("treatment_documents"."state" = 'purged') = ("treatment_documents"."file_sha256" is null)
        and ("treatment_documents"."state" = 'purged') = ("treatment_documents"."original_name" is null)
        and ("treatment_documents"."state" = 'purged') = ("treatment_documents"."purged_at" is not null)
